description:
This is a special notice to inform vendors that DLA Energy is conducting a live Question and Answer on May 14, 2026, from 0900-1200 EDT.

RSVP by May 13, 2026 to email address canada2026@dla.mil. The Zoom link will provided to you by your company email.


Registration Form - https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/XX2UUP7Yi8
